subtopics.title: Open sentences
performance_objectives: Solve problems expressed in open sentences
Identify the relationship between addition and subtraction; multiplication and division
teacher_activities: Guides students to find the missing number in an open statement using flash cards (e.g. box - 5 = 8; 7 + box = 11; box x 3 = 12; box = 12/3)
Guides students to solve more problems
Leads students to identify the relationship between addition and subtraction; and multiplication and division in open sentences
student_activities: Explain the relationship between addition and subtraction; and multiplication and division
teaching_learning_materials: Flash cards and open sentence charts
evaluation_guide: Find what given boxes in open sentences represent
Explain the relationship between (a) addition and subtraction, (b) multiplication and division, in open sentences

subtopics.title: Use of letters to represent symbols or shapes in open sentences

teaching_learning_materials: Flash cards and open sentence charts
evaluation_guide: Replace the boxes in given open sentence problems with letters

teaching_learning_materials: Flash cards and open sentence charts
evaluation_guide: Solve open sentence problems involving two arithmetic operations
